# UPchieve Changelog, week of Jul 26 to Aug 2, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Jul 30, subway Jul 30. These deploys carried much of what last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## Postgres read replica

A replica of the production database, so dev, testing, and debugging run against realistic data, and as the start of an analytics environment.

- 🚀 **A read-only role scoped to the `upchieve` schema.** The subscriber connects as this role, and it needs the whole schema so the initial subscription sync can copy every table. ([subway !2785](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2785)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🎁 **Subscriber setup and post-migration publication maintenance:** the subscription created on the replica, with the README walking through creating the slot and verifying it on both ends ([subway !2804](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2804)); a script that finds every `upchieve` table not already in the publication, adds it, and refreshes the subscription, run automatically after migrations so a newly added table starts replicating ([subway !2787](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2787)). *Alex Lindsay*

## Student → Volunteer (S2V)

Lets a student become a volunteer coach on the same account, switching modes instead of creating a second one, so they can earn verified volunteer service hours.

- 🚀 **Drop "Account" from the role label in the avatar menu.** It now reads Student, Coach, Teacher, or Coach Ambassador. Teacher had no mapping and fell through to Student, and the ambassador label changed from "Volunteer Ambassador" to "Coach Ambassador". ([high-line !1760](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1760)) *Macy Lam*

## End-to-end test suite

A browser test suite that drives high-line against a real subway, plus the work to make it run in CI.

- 🚀 **Run the CI end-to-end tests against mobile Chrome as well as desktop Chrome.** The suite blocks merges and was only covering one desktop browser. ([high-line !1793](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1793)) *Jamie Kasulis*

---

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Two new student post-session surveys.** A student now gets "Student Post-Session Survey Academics 1.0" if their session's subject is covered by it, the College Counseling survey if that one covers it instead, and the previous default otherwise. Which survey a student saw used to be decided by the `student-post-session-survey-variant` flag; the code no longer reads it and picks by subject instead. The new questions ask how confident the student feels solving problems like today's on their own, whether someone cares how they are doing academically, whether they belong to the community, and whether they can be accepted to, belong at, and earn a degree from a four-year college. They sit under a new "Your Academic Journey" heading, and a section heading now prints once instead of above every question in the section. ([subway !2822](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2822); [high-line !1791](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1791)) *Trey Stevens*
- **Coaches can set their own school**, which the peer-to-peer team asked for to target future outreach campaigns: 🚀 school, country, city, and state fields on the volunteer profile and background-info form, with the school search shown to coaches who are high school students in the US ([high-line !1795](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1795)); 🚀 the backend accepting the update ([subway !2826](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2826)); 🚀 a job that upserts the NCES private-school survey dataset, so a coach who does not attend a public school still gets a school on their account, using the 2021 to 2022 release since the 2023 to 2024 one is late ([subway !2820](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2820)); ✅ an event recording whether we have a high school coach's school ([high-line !1807](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1807)). *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🎁 **Removed the test that kept high school student coaches out of college-topic sessions.** College sessions are back in their open-sessions list, they get session notifications for those again, and the hourly texting job no longer filters them out. The `hs-students-barred-from-coaching-college-subjects` flag is switched off in PostHog and gone from both repos. ([subway !2828](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2828); [high-line !1799](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1799)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- ✅ **Delay some sessions on a coach's dashboard to protect the time of coaches with rare certifications.** A flag carries a list of high-priority subjects and a delay in milliseconds. A coach certified in one of those subjects sees those sessions immediately and every other session after the delay. The MR's example: a coach with a rare physics certification sees physics right away and a sixth-grade math session 30 seconds later, by which point one of the dozen other available coaches may have taken it. ([high-line !1808](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1808)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- **Screen image uploads with PhotoDNA before they are stored.** [#658](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/658): ✅ session photos upload through the backend ([subway !2757](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2757)); ✅ the front end sends volunteer photo IDs to the backend ([high-line !1711](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1711)); ✅ the backend receives them ([subway !2758](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2758)); ✅ a `quarantined_on` column on moderation infractions ([subway !2807](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2807)); 👀 the infraction's session id made nullable, since a quarantined volunteer photo ID does not come from a session ([subway !2832](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2832)); 👀 the moderation-infraction reads updated to match ([subway !2831](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2831)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **A proof of concept for running surveys through PostHog.** Demo only, off the back of more demand lately for rolling out new kinds of surveys. ([high-line !1794](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1794)) *Trey Stevens*
- 🎁 **Simplify how a teacher's class view calculates student assignment completion.** Building the completion map ran through several methods that were hard to follow; the student assignments are now attached to the assignments directly. ([high-line !1803](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1803)) *Alex Lindsay*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Redraw the progress-report chart once subjects finish loading.** The view renders a placeholder while the subjects store is still fetching, but its `mounted` hook drew the chart against a ref that only exists in the other branch, so refreshing the page left the chart blank. A watcher now regenerates it when the subjects arrive. 🐛 [#670](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/670) ([high-line !1796](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1796)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Offer only active subjects in the AI tutor's subject picker.** The picker listed every subject in the store, including inactive ones. It now uses the same requestable-subject list the dashboard does: active subjects, plus any the subject-request rollout flag has turned on. 🐛 [#679](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/679) ([high-line !1797](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1797)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Stop the chat alert sound and web notification from firing on your own messages and on audio you are already listening to.** On mobile with the document editor open, the notification sound played over the live voice call. It now stays silent for your own message or transcription, and for a partner's transcription when you are already on their audio. 🐛 [#682](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/682) ([high-line !1792](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1792)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Date the "Nationally Certified Tutor" certificate from the volunteer's first session.** The certificate always showed the day it was downloaded. It was meant to show when the volunteer passed the last of their onboarding certs, but the code read `lastAttemptedAt` off the wrong object, got undefined, and `dayjs(undefined)` returns today. The first session date is the better date anyway, since that is when the volunteer started providing value. 🐛 [#672](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/672) ([subway !2819](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2819); [high-line !1790](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1790)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Index the presence queries on `user_actions`.** Pulling the `ACTIVE_ON_SITE`, `PASSIVE_ON_SITE`, and `INACTIVE_ON_SITE` actions over a date range was doing a sequential scan. ([subway !2825](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2825)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Add the missing `topics` join to the volunteer post-session survey query.** PgTyped was failing it with "missing FROM-clause entry for table topics". ([subway !2823](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2823)) *Trey Stevens*
- 🎁 **Hide the favorite button on your own sessions.** Sessions you coached show up in your session history when you are in student mode, so you could favorite yourself as a good coach. 🐛 [#677](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/677) ([high-line !1801](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1801)) *sammy nave*
- 🎁 **Show one "Applications" option in the session-history subject filter.** Two College Counseling subjects share the display name, so the dropdown listed it twice. 🐛 [#674](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/674) ([high-line !1798](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1798)) *sammy nave*
- 🎁 **Keep `[object Object]` out of the session-history URL.** The filtered-session list was stored inside the `filters` object, which gets serialized into the query string, so an array of session objects ended up in the URL. It now lives outside the filters. 🐛 [#678](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/678) ([high-line !1802](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1802)) *sammy nave*
- 🎁 **Treat a grade level of "Other" as ineligible on the backend.** Front-end signup already blocked it; the eligibility check now sends these users to the request form instead. 🐛 [#671](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/671) ([subway !2824](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2824)) *Trey Stevens*
- 🎁 **Log the reason an SSO registration failed.** Google SSO registration was returning `Unknown server error`, which is the generic message you get when nothing is passed to `failureRedirect`, and the logs said nothing more. ([subway !2827](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2827)) *Alex Lindsay*
- **Upload the files a teacher attaches when editing an assignment.** The edit modal accepted attachments and dropped them, because the upload was a separate request from the assignment update. Create and edit now run through one upsert on both sides. 🐛 [#653](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/653): ✅ an `AssignmentService` on the front end, since creating from the teacher dashboard had already diverged and skipped the file upload ([high-line !1805](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1805)); ✅ the service pointed at the new endpoints ([high-line !1811](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1811)); ✅ file upload folded into the service's upsert request ([high-line !1812](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1812)); ✅ the views switched over to the service ([high-line !1806](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1806)); ✅ the modal held open under a loading overlay while the request runs, so a failure no longer closes it and discards the teacher's work, and the retry is safe ([high-line !1813](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1813)); 👀 one `upsertAssignment` query behind both create and edit ([subway !2830](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2830)); 👀 a `PUT /assignment` endpoint on top of it ([subway !2835](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2835)); 👀 a separate endpoint for assigning to multiple classes, since the old one took the selected students and assigned them even when they were not in the class, so a teacher saw students on an assignment who were not in it ([subway !2829](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2829)); 👀 file upload folded into the backend upsert ([subway !2837](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2837)); 👀 a check that the teacher owns the class or assignment, which any teacher could previously edit ([subway !2836](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2836)); 👀 the now-unused assignment methods and routes removed ([subway !2838](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2838)); 👀 class and student selection in the modal simplified to the single class it always is ([high-line !1804](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1804)); 👀 the edited assignment updated in the list afterwards, which was reading `response.assignment` instead of `response.data.assignment` ([high-line !1810](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1810)). *Alex Lindsay*
